title: cordia krauseana
intro: Cordia krauseana, commonly known as the "Gloriosa Lily of the forest", is a species of flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cordia krauseana include reducing fever, soothing skin irritations, and treating respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Cordia krauseana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
